---
title: "AI vs. Non-AI Careers"
author: "Lutong Wen, Maria Taylor Gonzalez, Sebastian Schwarz, and Hye Won Kim"
date: "2026-05-28"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
    toc: true
---

This project analyzes how artificial intelligence is reshaping career opportunities in the 2024 U.S. job market. Using the Lightcast 2024 job postings dataset, our team compares AI-related and non-AI careers across industries, occupations, skills, and experience levels.

Through data cleaning, exploratory analysis, skill gap analysis, and predictive modeling, we examine where AI-related jobs are most concentrated and what skills job seekers may need to stay competitive. Our analysis suggests that AI-related opportunities are not limited to highly technical roles. Instead, AI is becoming relevant across business, finance, healthcare, education, technology, and professional services.

Overall, this project translates job market data into practical career strategy. The main takeaway is that job seekers should not only focus on becoming AI specialists, but should also build AI-adjacent skills, applied data capabilities, industry knowledge, and strong communication skills.
